Question and plan cards now follow where you typed your last message, and no longer switch to the engine's dialog after a minute while you are still reading at the terminal.

- Typed at the terminal: the card opens and stays until you answer, even with Remote Control attached. Before, a Remote Control session handed the card over to the engine's default dialog after a minute without a touch, which happened while you were reading a long plan or thinking it over
- Typed in the Claude app (Remote Control), or from a phone through [collie](https://github.com/AltanS/collie) in a herdr pane: the engine's default dialog opens right away, so you can answer there. A collie prompt is recognized by its send record for this pane in the last 20 seconds (`~/.local/state/collie/sends`)
- A question asked after you typed at the terminal and walked away does not reach the app until you send a message from it

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
